milestone.completion_rule: M3 is complete only when M1 and M2 are complete and every component below has passed all of its checks with no remaining condition: Heap/Theap bootstrap, page queues, local allocation/free, retirement/reuse, the complete reachable bin/page-class matrix, deterministic C/Rust differential traces, Miri-compatible execution, and persistent-owner local operation.
nonclaims: No remote-free, abandonment, reclaim, thread-exit, or cross-thread lifetime behavior (M5).
No calloc, realloc, aligned, usable-size, explicit collection, or OOM-preservation behavior (M4).
No public mi_* API, libc integration, backend selection, or AArch64 evidence.

profile.description: The pinned C default Theap with mi_option_page_full_retain = -1 (allow_page_abandon = false) and the Rust SingleThreadAllocator's non-abandoning ExclusiveTheapSession, each over one committed, pinned, zero, nonexclusive in-place arena of arena_bytes aligned to MI_ARENA_ALIGNMENT.

persistent_owner_profile.description: The production persistent owners through native_allocate_aligned(size, 16)/native_free, compared with the pinned C default Theap through mi_malloc_aligned(size, 16)/mi_free, with default options and each owner's own default arena. Each (workload, owner) pair runs in a fresh process. Workloads keep every bin's live blocks below one page's reserved count and exclude singletons, so no page fills and the default abandoning Theap never reaches the M5 abandonment transition.

components.source_scope: src/init.c _mi_theap_empty/MI_PAGE_QUEUES_EMPTY images and src/theap.c _mi_theap_init/mi_theap_options_init for the page-bearing local Theap: queue block sizes, empty direct cache, retired bounds, counters, and page-full/abandon/reclaim option image.
src/page-queue.c queue push/remove/enqueue_from/enqueue_from_full/move_to_front, direct-cache update, and BIN_FULL membership with pages_full_size.
src/alloc.c small/direct and generic allocation, src/page.c mi_find_page/mi_page_queue_find_free_ex/fresh pages/extend, and src/free.c owner-local mi_free_block_local with unfull.
src/page.c _mi_page_retire/_mi_page_free, src/theap.c _mi_theap_collect_retired, quick-collect reuse, candidate search, and generic mini/full administration.
Every reachable x86-64 MI_ALIGN2W regular bin (direct-small, small, medium, large) and the huge singleton bin through create, full, unfull, retire, release, and retired reuse per class.
Separate pinned-C and Rust processes over generated workloads with logical allocation IDs and normalized page/queue/cache/counter state; repeated C runs are byte-identical.

Strict-provenance Miri (Stacked Borrows) over the complete local trace engine and page geometry: arena management, PageMap initialize/register/unregister/destroy, fresh pages, intrusive queue and full-queue transitions, free-list extend/pop/push/collect, retirement and release, with provenance, initialization, pointer arithmetic, and mapping lifetimes through crabc-core's cfg(miri) kernel model beneath the unchanged os.rs.

plan.md Production architecture 1: the initial and each later persistent owner retain their TLD/Theap and run the same local allocation/free/queue/retirement transitions through the production native_allocate_aligned/native_free boundary.
